guides.title: 原理、算例與驗證：橢圓偏光儀建置
guides.titleEn: Principles, examples and verification: Ellipsometer construction
guides.concept: 以反射偏振比 ρ = tanΨ·e^{iΔ} 為核心，說明橢圓偏光儀為何能把薄膜厚度量到次埃，再逐步建置光源、偏光鏡、補償器、測角儀與旋轉檢偏鏡，並用 SiO₂/Si 參考片把校正、參數相關性、視窗雙折射與量規重複性整合成可交接的儀器。
guides.conceptEn: Built around the reflection polarization ratio ρ = tanΨ·e^{iΔ}, this course explains why an ellipsometer resolves film thickness to sub-ångström level, then assembles source, polarizer, compensator, goniometer and rotating analyzer step by step, using SiO₂/Si reference wafers to tie calibration, parameter correlation, window birefringence and gauge repeatability into a hand-over-ready instrument.
procedure: 橢圓偏光儀不量反射率的絕對值，而是量 p 偏振與 s 偏振反射係數的複數比 ρ = r_p/r_s = tanΨ·e^{iΔ}：Ψ 描述振幅比、Δ 描述相位差。因為是比值，光源強度漂移、偵測器增益變化與視窗穿透率都在第一階消去，這是它能把薄膜厚度解析到 0.01 nm 等級的根本原因。入射角選在基板布魯斯特角附近時 r_p 最小而 ρ 對薄膜最敏感；對矽（633 nm 時 n ≈ 3.88）布魯斯特角約 75.5°，所以商用儀器多在 65–75° 工作。系統邊界是：一束已知偏振的準直光、一個角度已知的反射面、一個能解出偏振態的分析臂。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「反射偏振比 ρ 與入射角」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

單層薄膜的反射係數由兩個界面的菲涅耳係數與膜內相位厚度 β = 2π(d/λ)·√(n₁² − sin²φ) 組成：r = (r₀₁ + r₁₂e^{−2iβ})/(1 + r₀₁r₁₂e^{−2iβ})，p 與 s 各算一次再取比值得到 ρ(d, n₁, n₂, φ, λ)。量測得到 Ψ、Δ 之後，厚度與折射率是以模型擬合反解，而不是直接讀出。對很薄的膜，Δ 對厚度的靈敏度極高而 Ψ 幾乎不動；膜厚增加到數十奈米後 Ψ 開始承擔厚度資訊；當 β 累積到 π 時 Ψ、Δ 回到起點，產生厚度週期性的多解。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「SiO₂/Si 薄膜的菲涅耳—艾里模型」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

光譜型橢偏儀的光源常用 75 W 氙燈或氘燈加鹵素燈，覆蓋 190–1700 nm；單波長儀器用氦氖雷射或 LED。偏光鏡與檢偏鏡用方解石格蘭—泰勒稜鏡，消光比可達 10⁻⁵–10⁻⁶，深紫外改用 MgF₂ 羅瓊稜鏡。補償器是一片提供約四分之一波相位延遲的雙折射波片，讓儀器在 Δ 接近 0° 或 180° 時仍有相位靈敏度；旋轉補償器型（RCE）用它作為調制元件，並藉由 Δ 的正負號辨識消除 RAE 的符號模糊。偵測端以光柵光譜儀配 Si CCD 與 InGaAs 陣列同時讀出數百個波長。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「格蘭—泰勒偏光鏡與 MgF₂ 補償器」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

光源臂與偵測臂裝在同軸的雙臂測角儀上，轉軸必須通過樣品表面：若樣品高度偏離轉軸，改變入射角時光點會在樣品上移動且反射光偏離偵測器。入射角由編碼器讀出並以直通位置（φ = 90°）歸零；樣品傾斜由四象限偵測器或自準直系統在量測前調平。因為 Δ 對入射角極度敏感，角度與傾斜的機械精度直接轉成薄膜參數的系統誤差，所以測角儀的軸承、編碼器與樣品台的 z 軸都屬於光學量測鏈的一部分。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「雙臂測角儀與樣品台」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

旋轉檢偏鏡型（RAE）儀器讓檢偏鏡以固定轉速旋轉，偵測器訊號為 I(A) = I₀[1 + α·cos2A + β·sin2A]，以鎖相或數位傅立葉分析取出正規化係數 α、β。在偏光鏡方位 P 已知時，tanΨ = |tanP|·√((1 + α)/(1 − α))、cosΔ = β/√(1 − α²)。這組公式假設 P 與 A 的零點完全對準，因此建置時要做回歸校正：在多個 P 值下量 α、β，擬合殘差函數找出偏光鏡與檢偏鏡的方位偏置及偵測器衰減係數，再把它們寫進軟體。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「旋轉檢偏鏡傅立葉係數 α、β」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

橢偏結果的不確定度不只來自 Ψ、Δ 的雜訊，更多來自模型：厚度 d 與折射率 n 在很薄的膜中高度相關，因為 Δ 的一階變化只取決於 (n² − 1)·d/n² 這類組合，單一波長無法把兩者分開；表面粗糙層、界面層與基板光學常數的選擇也會把誤差推到厚度上。擬合以均方誤差 MSE 衡量，並用參數的 90% 信賴區間與相關矩陣判斷結果是否可信；光譜與多角度資料增加獨立觀測量，是打破相關性的主要手段。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「MSE 擬合與 n–d 相關性」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

把橢偏儀裝到鍍膜或蝕刻腔上做原位量測時，光必須穿過真空視窗，而視窗中的殘餘應力雙折射會對 Δ 加上偏置；應力自由熔融石英視窗與回歸式視窗校正（在腔內放已知樣品、擬合視窗延遲）是標準做法。晶圓廠的量測機台則把樣品對準自動化：四象限偵測器讀取反射光位置、Z 軸自動對焦、R-θ 平台做晶圓圖掃描，並把每一點的對準殘差記錄下來作為資料品質指標。溫度也是整合變數，基板光學常數隨溫度變化會被誤判成厚度。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「應力自由視窗與原位量測」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

橢偏儀的交接以量規重複性與再現性（GR&R）為核心：同一片參考片連續量測得到重複性，隔日、換人、重新裝載得到再現性，兩者合成的總變異與製程容差相比得到精度／容差比。多台機台則以同一組參考片做機台比對，要求平均值差異落在容差的一小部分內。驗收報告要列出參考片編號、量測配方（角度、波長範圍、模型）、各項標準差、相關矩陣與校正日期，使後續任何結果都能回溯到這份基準。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「參考片與量規 R&R 報告」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
procedureEn: An ellipsometer does not measure absolute reflectance but the complex ratio of the p- and s-polarized reflection coefficients, ρ = r_p/r_s = tanΨ·e^{iΔ}, where Ψ describes the amplitude ratio and Δ the phase difference. Because it is a ratio, source drift, detector gain changes and window transmission cancel to first order, which is the root reason the technique resolves film thickness at the 0.01 nm level. Choosing the angle of incidence near the substrate's Brewster angle minimises r_p and maximises the sensitivity of ρ to a film; for silicon (n ≈ 3.88 at 633 nm) the Brewster angle is about 75.5°, so commercial instruments work at 65–75°. The system boundary is a collimated beam of known polarization, a reflecting surface at a known angle, and an analysis arm able to solve for the polarization state. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Reflection ratio ρ and angle of incidence”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

A single film's reflection coefficient combines the Fresnel coefficients of its two interfaces with the film phase thickness β = 2π(d/λ)·√(n₁² − sin²φ): r = (r₀₁ + r₁₂e^{−2iβ})/(1 + r₀₁r₁₂e^{−2iβ}), evaluated for p and s and then ratioed to give ρ(d, n₁, n₂, φ, λ). Thickness and index are recovered by fitting this model to the measured Ψ and Δ, not read directly. For very thin films Δ is extremely sensitive to thickness while Ψ hardly moves; beyond a few tens of nanometres Ψ takes over the thickness information; and once β accumulates to π, Ψ and Δ return to their starting values, producing periodic thickness ambiguity. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Fresnel–Airy model of SiO₂/Si films”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

A spectroscopic ellipsometer typically uses a 75 W xenon lamp or deuterium plus halogen lamps covering 190–1700 nm, while single-wavelength instruments use a HeNe laser or LED. Polarizer and analyzer are calcite Glan–Taylor prisms with extinction ratios of 10⁻⁵–10⁻⁶, replaced by MgF₂ Rochon prisms in the deep ultraviolet. The compensator is a birefringent plate providing roughly quarter-wave retardance so that the instrument keeps phase sensitivity when Δ approaches 0° or 180°; a rotating-compensator ellipsometer (RCE) uses it as the modulating element and resolves the sign of Δ that an RAE cannot. The detection end uses a grating spectrograph with Si CCD and InGaAs arrays to read hundreds of wavelengths at once. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Glan–Taylor polarizers and the MgF₂ compensator”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Source and detector arms sit on a coaxial two-arm goniometer whose rotation axis must pass through the sample surface: if the sample height departs from the axis, the spot walks across the sample when the angle changes and the reflected beam leaves the detector. The angle of incidence is read from an encoder and zeroed at the straight-through position (φ = 90°); sample tilt is levelled before measurement with a quadrant detector or autocollimation. Because Δ is extremely sensitive to the angle of incidence, mechanical accuracy of angle and tilt converts directly into systematic film-parameter error, so the goniometer bearings, encoder and the z axis of the sample stage are part of the optical measurement chain. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Two-arm goniometer and sample stage”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

A rotating-analyzer ellipsometer (RAE) spins the analyzer at constant speed, and the detector signal is I(A) = I₀[1 + α·cos2A + β·sin2A], with the normalised coefficients α and β extracted by lock-in or digital Fourier analysis. With the polarizer azimuth P known, tanΨ = |tanP|·√((1 + α)/(1 − α)) and cosΔ = β/√(1 − α²). These formulas assume that the zero positions of P and A are exactly aligned, so construction includes a regression calibration: α and β are measured at several P values, a residual function is fitted to extract the polarizer and analyzer azimuth offsets and the detector attenuation factor, and these are written into the software. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Rotating-analyzer Fourier coefficients α and β”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

The uncertainty of an ellipsometric result comes less from noise in Ψ and Δ than from the model: thickness d and index n are strongly correlated for very thin films because the first-order change of Δ depends only on a combination such as (n² − 1)·d/n², which a single wavelength cannot separate; choices of surface-roughness layer, interface layer and substrate optical constants likewise push error into the thickness. Fits are judged by the mean-squared error (MSE), and 90% confidence limits and the correlation matrix of the parameters decide whether a result is trustworthy; spectroscopic and multi-angle data add independent observables and are the main way to break the correlation. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “MSE fitting and n–d correlation”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

When an ellipsometer is mounted on a deposition or etch chamber for in-situ measurement, the beam must pass vacuum viewports whose residual stress birefringence adds an offset to Δ; strain-free fused-silica windows plus a regression window calibration (a known sample inside the chamber, fitting the window retardance) are standard practice. Fab metrology tools automate sample alignment: a quadrant detector reads the reflected-beam position, the z axis autofocuses, an R-θ stage scans the wafer map, and the alignment residual at each point is logged as a data-quality indicator. Temperature is also an integration variable, because substrate optical constants changing with temperature can be misread as thickness. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Strain-free viewports and in-situ measurement”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Hand-over of an ellipsometer centres on gauge repeatability and reproducibility (GR&R): consecutive measurements of one reference wafer give repeatability, measurements on other days, by other operators and after reloading give reproducibility, and the combined variation compared with the process tolerance gives the precision-to-tolerance ratio. Several tools are matched with the same reference set, requiring mean differences within a small fraction of the tolerance. The acceptance record lists reference-wafer identifiers, the measurement recipe (angle, wavelength range, model), each standard deviation, the correlation matrix and calibration dates, so that every later result traces back to this baseline. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Reference wafers and gauge R&R record”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

pitfalls: 把橢偏儀當反射率計使用、拿單一角度的強度訊號推薄膜厚度，光源 1% 的漂移就會變成奈米級厚度誤差；真正的橢偏量測必須建立在 Ψ、Δ 這兩個比值型觀測量之上。
檢偏鏡馬達的編碼器與光學軸之間有 0.3° 的裝配偏置而未校正，α、β 的相位旋轉使 Ψ 偏 0.15°、Δ 偏 0.6°，每片薄膜的折射率都被系統性擬合偏高。
pitfallsEn: Using the ellipsometer as a reflectometer and inferring thickness from single-angle intensity turns a 1% source drift into nanometre-scale thickness error; a genuine ellipsometric measurement must rest on the ratio-type observables Ψ and Δ.

An uncalibrated 0.3° assembly offset between the analyzer motor encoder and the optical axis rotates the phase of α and β, biasing Ψ by 0.15° and Δ by 0.6°, so every film's refractive index fits systematically high.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 橢圓偏光儀建置
history.text: 德魯德在 1887–1890 年間推導出反射偏振理論並以此量測金屬上的薄膜，是橢偏術的起點；1945 年 Rothen 建造了第一台以此命名的「橢偏儀」。1975 年 Aspnes 與 Studna 發表自動化旋轉檢偏鏡橢偏儀，使 Ψ、Δ 能以電子方式快速取得；1980–90 年代光譜型與可變角度儀器商品化（J.A. Woollam 於 1987 年成立、法國 SOPRA、美國 Rudolph 等），橢偏儀隨後成為半導體廠閘極氧化層與多層膜的例行量測工具。本課重建的是公開的物理與建置邏輯，不涉及任何廠商的專有演算法。
history.textEn: Drude derived the theory of reflected polarization between 1887 and 1890 and used it to measure thin films on metals, the origin of ellipsometry; in 1945 Rothen built the first instrument to carry the name ellipsometer. In 1975 Aspnes and Studna published the automated rotating-analyzer ellipsometer, making Ψ and Δ available electronically and quickly; spectroscopic and variable-angle instruments were commercialised in the 1980s and 1990s (J.A. Woollam founded in 1987, SOPRA in France, Rudolph in the United States), and ellipsometers then became routine tools for gate oxides and multilayer stacks in semiconductor fabs. This course reconstructs public physics and construction logic, not any vendor's proprietary algorithm.

history.title: 從工程史到可驗證模型
history.titleEn: From engineering history to verifiable models
history.text: 本課把「橢偏量測的物理量與系統邊界」到「重複性、再現性與機台比對驗收」改寫為 32 個原創分析、量測與診斷任務；不複製來源圖片、影片逐字稿或現場程序。
history.textEn: The course turns "Ellipsometric observables and system boundaries" through "Repeatability, reproducibility and tool-matching acceptance" into 32 original analysis, measurement and diagnosis tasks without copying source images, video transcripts or field procedures.
